units.source_text: 祖父去世的那年八月，我舍弃了这个家，寄养在舅父家里。

en.t: In August of the year my grandfather died, I left this house behind and was taken in at my uncle's home.

units.source_text: 一想到祖父对这个家的挚爱，以及当时和以后把房屋连同地产都变卖了，我多少有点难过。

en.t: When I think of my grandfather's deep love for this house, and of how the house and land were sold off then and later, I feel somewhat sad.

units.source_text: 后来，随着辗转住在亲戚家、学校宿舍和公寓，我脑子里的家和家庭概念也渐渐淡薄了。

en.t: Later, as I moved from relatives' houses to school dormitories and rented rooms, the ideas of home and family in my mind gradually faded too.

units.source_text: 我净做些到处流浪的梦。

en.t: I kept having dreams of wandering from place to place.

units.source_text: 祖父甚至不愿让亲戚看我家的家谱，将家谱寄存在他最信赖的美代家里。

en.t: My grandfather would not even let relatives see our family genealogy, and he left it for safekeeping at the home of Miyo, whom he trusted most.

units.source_text: 这些家谱至今仍存放在美代家中的佛坛抽屉里，并且上了锁。

en.t: Those genealogies are still kept to this day in a locked drawer of the Buddhist altar in Miyo's house.
I have never thought of looking at them.

units.source_text: 但是，我对祖父问心无愧。

en.t: But I have a clear conscience toward my grandfather.

units.source_text: 因为我模模糊糊地相信死者的睿智和慈爱。

en.t: Because, in some vague way, I believe in the wisdom and compassion of the dead.
